description: Total cost of ownership for the EV vs an equivalent gasoline car: depreciation, fuel/electricity, maintenance, insurance and road tax

WITH car AS (
  SELECT c.model, c.marketing_name, c.efficiency,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY'))) / (365.25 * 86400) as eta_anni
  FROM cars c WHERE c.id = ${car_id}
),
dep_version AS (
  SELECT model, eta_anni,
    CASE
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range-awd'
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
    END as version
  FROM car
),
drive_agg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.distance), 0) as km_percorsi
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = ${car_id} AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
),
curve AS (
  SELECT dc.base_price, dc.coeff_age, dc.coeff_km
  FROM dep_version dv
  JOIN depreciation_curve dc ON dc.make = 'tesla' AND dc.model = dv.model AND dc.version = dv.version
  ORDER BY dc.computed_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT base_price * EXP(coeff_age * (SELECT eta_anni FROM car) + coeff_km * ((SELECT km_percorsi FROM drive_agg) / 10000.0)) FROM curve),
    NULLIF(${valore_mercato_manuale}::numeric, 0)
  ) as "Valore stimato attuale"

WITH car AS (

),

      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'

  FROM car
),
drive_agg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.distance), 0) as km_percorsi
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = ${car_id} AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
),
curve AS (
  SELECT dc.base_price, dc.coeff_age, dc.coeff_km
  FROM dep_version dv
  JOIN depreciation_curve dc ON dc.make = 'tesla' AND dc.model = dv.model AND dc.version = dv.version
  ORDER BY dc.computed_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ${valore_contanti}::numeric - COALESCE(

  WHERE car_id = ${car_id} AND cost IS NOT NULL AND charge_energy_added > 0
),
car AS (
  SELECT c.model, c.marketing_name, c.efficiency,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY'))) / (365.25 * 86400) as eta_anni
  FROM cars c WHERE c.id = ${car_id}
),
dep_version AS (
  SELECT model, eta_anni,
    CASE
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range-awd'
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
    END as version
  FROM car
),
drive_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(d.distance), 0) as km_percorsi,
    COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * car.efficiency, 0)), 0) as kwh_totale
  FROM drives d CROSS JOIN car
  WHERE d.car_id = ${car_id} AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
),
curve AS (
  SELECT dc.base_price, dc.coeff_age, dc.coeff_km
  FROM dep_version dv
  JOIN depreciation_curve dc ON dc.make = 'tesla' AND dc.model = dv.model AND dc.version = dv.version
  ORDER BY dc.computed_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT eta_anni FROM car) as eta_anni,
    ${valore_contanti}::numeric - COALESCE(
      (SELECT base_price * EXP(coeff_age * (SELECT eta_anni FROM car) + coeff_km * ((SELECT km_percorsi FROM drive_agg) / 10000.0)) FROM curve),
      NULLIF(${valore_mercato_manuale}::numeric, 0)
    ) as deprezzamento,
    (SELECT kwh_totale FROM drive_agg) * (SELECT price_per_kwh FROM elec) as costo_elettricita
)
SELECT
  deprezzamento
  + costo_elettricita
  + eta_anni * ${manutenzione_ev_anno}::numeric
  + eta_anni * ${assicurazione_annua}::numeric
  + GREATEST(eta_anni - ${anni_esenzione_bollo}::numeric, 0) * ${bollo_annuo}::numeric as "TCO EV cumulativo"
FROM totals

WITH car AS (

dep_version AS (

      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
    END as version
  FROM car
),
drive_agg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.distance), 0) as km_percorsi
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = ${car_id} AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')

fuel_cost AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM((d.distance / 100.0) * ${consumo_ice_l100km} * fp.price_per_liter), 0) as costo_carburante_ice
  FROM drives d
  JOIN LATERAL (

  ) fp ON true

curve AS (

  FROM dep_version dv
  JOIN depreciation_curve dc ON dc.make = 'tesla' AND dc.model = dv.model AND dc.version = dv.version

    (SELECT eta_anni FROM car) as eta_anni,
    ${valore_contanti}::numeric - COALESCE(

      NULLIF(${valore_mercato_manuale}::numeric, 0)

)
SELECT

  + costo_carburante_ice
  + eta_anni * ${manutenzione_ice_anno}::numeric
  + eta_anni * ${assicurazione_annua}::numeric
  + GREATEST(eta_anni - ${anni_esenzione_bollo}::numeric, 0) * ${bollo_annuo}::numeric as "TCO ICE equivalente"
FROM totals

WITH elec AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(charge_energy_added), 0), ${electricity_price}::numeric) as price_per_kwh
  FROM charging_processes
  WHERE car_id = ${car_id} AND cost IS NOT NULL AND charge_energy_added > 0
),
car AS (
  SELECT c.efficiency FROM cars c WHERE c.id = ${car_id}
),
drive_agg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * car.efficiency, 0)), 0) as kwh_totale
  FROM drives d CROSS JOIN car
  WHERE d.car_id = ${car_id} AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
),
fuel_cost AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM((d.distance / 100.0) * ${consumo_ice_l100km} * fp.price_per_liter), 0) as costo_carburante_ice
  FROM drives d

    SELECT price_per_liter FROM fuel_prices WHERE week_start <= d.start_date::date ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
  ) fp ON true
  WHERE d.car_id = ${car_id} AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
)
SELECT
  (SELECT costo_carburante_ice FROM fuel_cost)
  + (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY'))) / (365.25 * 86400)) * ${manutenzione_ice_anno}::numeric
  - (SELECT kwh_totale FROM drive_agg) * (SELECT price_per_kwh FROM elec)
  - (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY'))) / (365.25 * 86400)) * ${manutenzione_ev_anno}::numeric as "Risparmio netto (carburante + manutenzione)"
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY'))) / (365.25 * 86400) as "Anni di possesso"

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) as "Km percorsi"
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = ${car_id} AND distance > 0 AND start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')

WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('week', TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')), date_trunc('week', now()), interval '1 week') as week_start
),
car AS (
  SELECT c.model, c.marketing_name, c.efficiency FROM cars c WHERE c.id = ${car_id}
),
dep_version AS (
  SELECT model,
    CASE
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range-awd'
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'Y' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = '3' AND marketing_name = 'RWD' THEN 'standard-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'S' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'LR AWD' THEN 'long-range'
      WHEN model = 'X' AND marketing_name = 'Performance' THEN 'performance'
    END as version
  FROM car
),
elec AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(charge_energy_added), 0), ${electricity_price}::numeric) as price_per_kwh
  FROM charging_processes
  WHERE car_id = ${car_id} AND cost IS NOT NULL AND charge_energy_added > 0
),
curve AS (
  SELECT dc.base_price, dc.coeff_age, dc.coeff_km
  FROM dep_version dv
  JOIN depreciation_curve dc ON dc.make = 'tesla' AND dc.model = dv.model AND dc.version = dv.version
  ORDER BY dc.computed_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
weekly_drive AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('week', d.start_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Rome') as week_start,
    SUM(GREATEST((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * car.efficiency, 0)) as kwh,
    SUM(d.distance) as km,
    SUM((d.distance / 100.0) * ${consumo_ice_l100km} * fp.price_per_liter) as ice_fuel_cost
  FROM drives d
  CROSS JOIN car
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT price_per_liter FROM fuel_prices WHERE week_start <= d.start_date::date ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
  ) fp ON true
  WHERE d.car_id = ${car_id} AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY')
  GROUP BY 1
),
cum AS (
  SELECT
    w.week_start,
    GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (w.week_start - TO_TIMESTAMP('${data_acquisto}', 'DD/MM/YYYY'))) / (365.25 * 86400), 0) as eta_anni_at_week,
    SUM(COALESCE(wd.kwh, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY w.week_start) as kwh_cum,
    SUM(COALESCE(wd.km, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY w.week_start) as km_cum,
    SUM(COALESCE(wd.ice_fuel_cost, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY w.week_start) as ice_fuel_cost_cum
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN weekly_drive wd ON wd.week_start = w.week_start
)
SELECT
  cum.week_start as time,
  ROUND((
    (${valore_contanti}::numeric - COALESCE((SELECT base_price * EXP(coeff_age * cum.eta_anni_at_week + coeff_km * (cum.km_cum / 10000.0)) FROM curve), NULLIF(${valore_mercato_manuale}::numeric, 0)))
    + cum.kwh_cum * (SELECT price_per_kwh FROM elec)
    + cum.eta_anni_at_week * ${manutenzione_ev_anno}::numeric
    + cum.eta_anni_at_week * ${assicurazione_annua}::numeric
    + GREATEST(cum.eta_anni_at_week - ${anni_esenzione_bollo}::numeric, 0) * ${bollo_annuo}::numeric
  )::numeric, 2) as "TCO EV",
  ROUND((
    (${valore_contanti}::numeric - COALESCE((SELECT base_price * EXP(coeff_age * cum.eta_anni_at_week + coeff_km * (cum.km_cum / 10000.0)) FROM curve), NULLIF(${valore_mercato_manuale}::numeric, 0)))
    + cum.ice_fuel_cost_cum
    + cum.eta_anni_at_week * ${manutenzione_ice_anno}::numeric
    + cum.eta_anni_at_week * ${assicurazione_annua}::numeric
    + GREATEST(cum.eta_anni_at_week - ${anni_esenzione_bollo}::numeric, 0) * ${bollo_annuo}::numeric
  )::numeric, 2) as "TCO ICE equivalente"
FROM cum
ORDER BY cum.week_start

options.content:
**Assunzioni V1 di questa dashboard**

- Valore attuale di mercato: preso da `depreciation_curve` (aggiornata dallo scraper `market-value-fetcher`); se non c'e ancora una riga per questo modello/versione, viene usato `valore_mercato_manuale` come fallback.
- Deprezzamento e assunto identico per lo scenario EV e per lo scenario ICE equivalente: il confronto si concentra sulla differenza di carburante/elettricita e manutenzione.
- Bollo, assicurazione e manutenzione sono impostati come variabili dashboard con valore fisso annuo (non storicizzati nel DB). Se cambiano nel tempo, aggiorna la variabile.
- Bollo: esente per i primi `anni_esenzione_bollo` anni dall'acquisto, poi `bollo_annuo`/anno.
- Compila `valore_contanti` e `data_acquisto` prima di leggere i pannelli: senza questi valori le query restituiscono errore.
